actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of the initial endowment, so the Conserve Resources rule caps contribution at 30% of the wallet (~0.69). Round 15 is a multiple of 5, triggering the norm broadcast.
